snippet.title: Leonardo's Island old cinematic trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Leonardo’s Island – the ultimate shipbuilding and naval combat experience!
Design and upgrade your own fleet from the keel up. Customize hulls, sails, cannons, and special equipment to fit your battle style. Whether you’re racing to victory in competitive regattas or engaging in fast-paced PvP sea battles, every match brings new opportunities to earn gold and experience.

Unlock advanced ship classes, enhance your firepower, and outmaneuver your enemies in real-time multiplayer combat. With deep progression and strategic customization, every choice on the water counts.

⚓ Build your fleet. Master the seas. Prove your skill.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1449590

P.S. Here is the first version of the trailer. As I'm still working on the battles part, I’ll be posting an update soon that includes combat and more gameplay footage. Stay tuned!
